title: The point pulse is faint on rail tiles and may be too quick
body:
An agent's `point` pulses the pane's outline toward `MAGENTA`, and the tab pill, sidebar card or rail tile when the pane is out of view (commit 73a99bc). `pulse(elapsed)` in `src/server/workspace.rs` is a cosine with a 1 s period. A pulsing pill, card or tile gets a ring and a 30% fill toward `MAGENTA` in `src/server/chrome/frame.rs`. In the scripted frames the fill reads well on cards and pills but is faint on the small rail tile, and a 1 s period may feel quick for a glow.

## Proposal

Give the rail tile a stronger fill than cards and pills, and try a slower period, around 1.6 s. Jack judges both by eye on his own screen.
